answer: Make every agent stake reputation it can actually lose: a new identity starts with zero trust and only earns spending rights by doing verified work over time. Like an oasis that survives because its water is metered, an economy should meter privileges — one attested task, one small allowance — so a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand times the effort. Sable-dark clone farms fail when each identity must prove a unique, costly history before reaching the zenith of full access. Sybil resistance is not a wall, it is a slow ladder.
